name: conflicting-start-dates
description: Conflicting values: two evidence fragments assert different event start dates. The pipeline must preserve both candidates or surface a conflict issue; it must never silently pick a winner.

evidence.text: The client intake form states the event start date is 2026-10-05.
The venue hold letter states the event start date is 2026-10-12.
The event is named Synthetic Conflict Congress.
